# Figure 5. GWAS

{{< include ../../_extensions/gaospecial/fig-export/_setup.qmd >}}

{{< include _theme-setup.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# ============================================================
# Figure 5 — overlapping Manhattan plot
# 数据来源: ASV1 (Pantoea) 和 ASV2 (Burkholderia) 的 BLINK GWAS 结果
# 压缩数据: data/processed/gwas/manhattan/fig5_asv1_asv2_manhattan.rds
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

gwas_data <- readRDS("data/processed/gwas/manhattan/fig5_asv1_asv2_manhattan.rds")

gwas_p_summary <- data.frame(
  chr = gwas_data$chr,
  pos = gwas_data$pos,
  Pantoea = gwas_data$p_value[, 1],
  Burkholderia = gwas_data$p_value[, 2],
  check.names = FALSE
)

p_threshold <- 1 / 280000

gwas_long <- gwas_p_summary |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Pantoea, Burkholderia),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "P"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    logP = -log10(P),
    significant = P < p_threshold
  )

chr_sizes <- gwas_long |>
  group_by(chr) |>
  summarise(chr_len = max(pos), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(chr) |>
  mutate(
    offset = lag(cumsum(chr_len), default = 0),
    center = offset + chr_len / 2,
    chr_bg = ifelse(chr %% 2 == 1, "gray70", "gray40")
  )

gwas_long <- gwas_long |>
  left_join(chr_sizes, by = "chr") |>
  mutate(BPcum = pos + offset)

# 非显著位点仅用于背景密度显示；按 5 kb 窗口保留最小 P 值，
# 显著位点全部保留。统计分析仍使用完整数据。
gwas_plot <- as.data.table(gwas_long)
gwas_plot[, window := pos %/% 5000L]

plot_columns <- c(
  "chr", "pos", "Trait", "P", "logP", "significant",
  "chr_bg", "center", "offset", "BPcum"
)

gwas_background <- gwas_plot[
  significant == FALSE,
  .SD[which.min(P)],
  by = .(Trait, chr, window)
][, ..plot_columns]

gwas_plot <- rbindlist(list(
  gwas_plot[significant == TRUE, ..plot_columns],
  gwas_background
))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig5-composite
#| fig-cap: "图5 重叠曼哈顿图：Pantoea (ASV1) 与 Burkholderia (ASV2)"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| warning: false
#| message: false

top2_overlay_manhattan <- ggplot() +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
    geom_point(
      data = subset(gwas_plot, !significant),
      aes(BPcum, logP, color = chr_bg),
      alpha = 0.25,
      size = 0.4
    ),
    dpi = 300
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
    geom_point(
      data = subset(gwas_plot, significant),
      aes(BPcum, logP, color = Trait),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 0.9
    ),
    dpi = 300
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      Pantoea = "#3C5488",
      Burkholderia = "#E64B35",
      gray70 = "gray70",
      gray40 = "gray40"
    ),
    breaks = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia")
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(p_threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = chr_sizes$center,
    labels = paste0("Chr", chr_sizes$chr),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(P)))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.0, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")
  )

top2_overlay_manhattan
```
